about: Expected set_workspace_view calls for group B (and E3 = B1 in French). A question passes when any set_workspace_view call matches one of the listed argument specs: a string must equal the argument, a list lists accepted values, {"regex": ...} must match. Written from site/workspace-tools.js and site/workspace.js applySettings on 2026-11-10; unconfirmed until Nic confirms.

questions.expected: Reef & lagoon temperature at the backreef over the 2019 bleaching, or the heatwave_2019_reef bookmark.

checks.text: Opens backreef water temperature in a 2019 window (or the 2019 reef heatwave bookmark).

questions.note: The reef_temperature view takes no window or zone through the tool, so opening it is accepted. A btm_ variable at an LTER station without a zone is accepted only because backreef is one of that station's zones; Nic may want to require the zone.

questions.expected: Experiments page, study 5053.1 (Caging × habitat, Acropora pulchra).

checks.text: Opens the Experiments page at study 5053.1.

questions.expected: The Fish page, or the fish-by-trophic-group preset, or the herbivore response in the coupling view.

checks.text: Opens fish by trophic group (Fish page, fish preset or herbivore coupling).

questions.note: The tool cannot choose LTER 3 or herbivores on the Fish page (view "fish" takes no settings), so the check cannot require them. Whether the answer tells the user to pick LTER 3 is for the judge.

questions.expected: Moorings: ocean family, FOR01, a wave-height variable, July 2024.

checks.text: Opens FOR01 wave height for July 2024.

questions.note: Family is not required because ocean is the default.

questions.expected: Coupling view: a thermal driver against a coral response.

checks.text: Opens the coupling view with a thermal driver and a coral response.
